_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.
name: thicc ben

anim._doc: T-083. Spec: research/fable-tickets.md section 1.3 (the 1.x tables are the spec; ENEMIES.md behavior sentences are frozen per D-040). One entry per table row, keyed by a snake_case state id; 'row' repeats the exact table row label. spec_frames are the section 1.3 frame names in table order; frames are the files that exist on disk, relative to this folder (T-016 produced TBD placeholders - thiccben_00 maps onto cycle_00, see frame_map and DECISIONS D-T083-1/D-T083-2). Timings are in 60 Hz ticks and are binding; the attack frame lands on the tick its kill resolves. Effects are shader/transform effects on the billboard and never change body_rect.

params.note: parked until 75 ticks before the next teleport (interval 801 ticks = 13.35 s); a clock tower does not bob

params.old_position: ben's own sprite fades alpha 1 -> 0 over the first 30 ticks at the old position
params.chime: in the last 30 ticks (0.5 s, the Westminster chime) the smoke pulses red twice
params.note: 75 ticks (1.25 s); ben's own sprite fades out over the first 30 ticks at the old position; the smoke column stands at the destination for the full cue
appears at full alpha on tick 75, the tick the lock is resolved; white flash on the sprite for 6 ticks
on touch: sprite rocks +/- 8 degrees twice; a ring wave expands to 8 u (the cleanse radius) in 18 ticks
